author: Claude (Marcel's project start)
machine: Marcel's laptop, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Laptop GPU only (no Intel UHD present); background load ~50 % CPU from other apps during the runs
method: Visible CDP Chrome (port 9231), 1280x800 viewport, ?track=stadionring&weather=sun&demo=1, Grand Prix via tests/cdp.mjs startGrandPrix, 12 s into the race, photo mode; quality switched with the options button (Standard -> Hoch -> Basis -> Standard, so Basis and Standard are measured after Hoch was visited, as in normal toggling). 150 rAF intervals; gpu/cpu from Babylon EngineInstrumentation/SceneInstrumentation averages. Runs interleaved old/new/old/new via git stash of src/main.ts and src/slice-scene.ts.
changes: SSAO2 dispose(true): leaving Hoch now also disables the geometry-buffer renderer, which otherwise kept redrawing every mesh each frame in Standard and Basis
Glow map refreshRate 2 (blurred occluder pass every second frame)
Minimap bounds cached per track instead of recomputed for every dot
reading: Draw calls halve in Basis (988 -> 457) and drop ~20 % in Standard; Basis p95 falls from 33 ms to 17 ms. Millisecond values swing with the machine's background load and are not a clean A/B. The quiet-machine practice-grid check before the glow change measured Basis 1097 -> 549 draws, gpu 12.0 -> 7.8 ms, cpu 19.7 -> 13.9 ms for the G-buffer fix alone. Intel UHD itself is not measured (issue #4 stays open).
notDone: Glass-pane triangle trim in the city kit showed no measurable change on this GPU and was reverted.
